chunks: From him, from Safwan, from Alāʾ ibn Razīn, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام: Game is hunted in the area outside the Haram, slaughtered outside the Haram, then brought into the Haram and eaten? He said: Yes, there is no harm in it.

key_terms.الْحَرَمَ: the sacred sanctuary with special legal restrictions
key_terms.الْحِلِّ: the area outside the sacred sanctuary where normal hunting rules apply
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it; it is permissible
key_terms.يُذْبَحُ: it is slaughtered according to the prescribed method

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat hunted game inside the Haram if it was hunted and slaughtered outside it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game in relation to the Haram. If the game is hunted and slaughtered in the lawful area outside the Haram, then brought into the Haram, eating it is permitted.
